ja.title: AlphaFold 3はRNAの形をどこまで当てられるか
ja.summary: AlphaFold 3のRNA予測を形と相対配置に分け、未知RNAへの信頼度の読み方を考える。文献の確認範囲を明示し、人工例で候補構成と採用精度の関係を示す。
ja.seo_description: AlphaFold 3のRNA予測を形と相対配置に分けて読む。人工例で未知候補の割合と採用精度の関係を示す。

en.title: How reliably does AlphaFold 3 predict RNA structure?
en.summary: Separate RNA folding from relative placement in AlphaFold 3 predictions. An explicitly artificial example shows how target composition changes selection precision.
en.seo_description: Separate RNA folding from relative placement in AlphaFold 3. An artificial example shows how novel-target composition changes selection precision.
